fields.label: User
fields.description: The login. One row per person, not per distributor: a depot has a storekeeper taking orders and an accountant chasing claims, and a shared login makes every audit trail useless.

fields.label: Distributor
fields.description: The one thing the whole portal is scoped by. Every query a portal session makes is narrowed to this profile, and a document belonging to anyone else is refused rather than hidden.

fields.label: Role At Depot
fields.description: What this person does at the depot. It labels the session on screen and in the ingest log; the two check boxes below are what actually decide anything.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Cleared when somebody leaves the depot. The login may still exist for other reasons, so access is revoked here rather than by deleting a User.

fields.label: May Accept Orders
fields.description: Moving an order through the queue commits the depot to supplying it. An accountant reading the same screen should not be able to.

fields.label: May Send Sales Files
fields.description: Whether this login may upload the depot's own secondary sales file. On by default: a depot that cannot send its sales is a depot whose sales nobody has.

fields.label: May Raise Claims
fields.description: Raising a claim asks us for money. A storekeeper who can accept an order has no business doing that.
